en.settings_app_icon_schedule_desc: Use one icon during the selected daily period and the icon chosen above at other times. Periods can cross midnight.
en.settings_app_icon_schedule_background_no: System timers pause while the app is in the background or closed. The icon is corrected for the current time when the app returns to the foreground.
en.settings_app_icon_schedule_invalid: Start and end times must be different.
en.settings_app_icon_schedule_save_failed: Could not save the icon schedule. Please try again.
en.settings_app_icon_schedule_fallback_save: Saved. This icon will be used outside the selected period.
en.settings_app_icon_unsupported: This system version cannot change app icons; HarmonyOS 7.0 or later is required.
en.settings_app_icon_mid_autumn_note: Mid-Autumn icon: available September 25 to 28 only. It switches back to the default icon afterwards.
en.settings_app_icon_mid_autumn_ended: The Mid-Autumn icon period has ended, so the default icon is back.
en.settings_app_icon_applied: Icon switched. The home screen will update shortly.
en.settings_app_icon_failed: Could not switch the icon. Please try again.
en.settings_app_icon_theme_conflict: The current theme supplies an icon for this app. Switch back to an official theme first.
en.settings_app_icon_clone: App clones cannot change the icon; use the main app instead.
en.settings_dark_surface_desc: Choose pure black or a softer deep-gray surface. Available when Dark is selected.
en.settings_font_preview: Posts are the heart of X. This preview updates as you change the size.
en.settings_font_system_hint: Text follows Accessibility → Text size and scales up to 1.75×.
en.settings_font_app_hint: Uses the in-app multiplier and ignores the system text size.
en.settings_font_restart_hint: Platform limit: once the in-app multiplier is used, this run cannot follow the system again. Restart the app to apply.
en.settings_font_restart_failed: Could not restart automatically — close and reopen the app
en.settings_content_font_hint: Choose the font for posts, quotes, details, and read-aloud text. Changes apply immediately.
en.settings_hds_tabs_material_note: Adjust the immersive material level of the Home HdsTabs bar. Changes apply immediately.
en.settings_timeline_columns_desc: Use a waterfall layout on wide screens to show more posts. Narrow screens stay single-column.
en.settings_auto_hide_note: Tuck the top title bar or the bottom navigation bar away as you read down, and bring them back when you scroll up or reach the top.
en.settings_auto_hide_title_bar_desc: Collapse the top title bar while scrolling down. It returns as soon as you scroll up or reach the top.
en.settings_custom_bottom_bar_desc: Choose which pages appear in the bottom navigation. Keep at least two pages enabled.
en.settings_custom_bottom_bar_page_desc: Show this page in the bottom navigation.
en.settings_home_header_collapse_desc: When enabled, the Home feed tabs move beside the avatar and the X logo fades out as you scroll down. Scroll up to restore them. Off by default.
en.settings_auto_hide_tab_bar_desc: Slide the bottom navigation bar away while scrolling down. It returns as soon as you scroll up or reach the top.
en.settings_auto_hide_fab: Hide the compose button while scrolling
en.settings_auto_hide_fab_desc: When on, the floating compose button steps aside while a list is moving and returns once scrolling stops. When off, it stays visible at all times.
en.settings_immersive_title_bar_blur_note: Choose how the title bar looks when content scrolls behind it. Immersive gradient ramps into a blur with the immersive light, Gradient uses the standard ramp, and Glass keeps only the system glass panel without blurring the content.
en.settings_immersive_title_bar_blur_switch: Pick immersive gradient blur, gradient blur or glass material.
en.settings_title_bar_glass_blur_off_desc: Keep only the glass panel and stop the blur from following the scroll.
en.settings_title_bar_glass_level_desc: Pick one of the five thickness levels of the HarmonyOS 7 material used by this glass.
en.settings_reply_capsule_material_level_de: Choose one of five system material thickness levels for the reply panel on post details.
en.settings_compose_button_desc: When on, the main interface shows the floating compose button. Turn it off to hide that entry.
en.settings_press_effect_desc: Slightly scale down post cards while they are pressed.
en.settings_push_desc: Automatically check notifications and direct messages and show unread dots. You can still check manually when off.
en.settings_system_notifications_desc: Publish HarmonyOS notifications for new alerts or direct messages and keep the launcher badge in sync.
en.settings_notification_dnd_silent_desc: When system Do Not Disturb is on, update only the in-app unread dot without posting system notifications.
en.settings_notification_system_settings_de: Open HarmonyOS notification management for banners, lock screen, sound, and vibration.
en.settings_notification_permission_needed: Allow Harmony X notifications in system settings
en.settings_notification_settings_failed: Unable to open system notification settings
en.settings_content_desc: Choose the default Home timeline, filter what you do not want to read, and control the read-aloud entry.
en.settings_default_feed_desc: The selected timeline loads first at launch. You can still switch from the top of Home.
en.settings_default_feed_for_you_desc: Recommended posts based on your interests and activity.
en.settings_default_feed_following_desc: Posts only from accounts you follow.
en.settings_filter_desc: These rules only change what this device shows. They do not unfollow, block, or change your X account settings.
en.settings_filter_only_media_desc: Hide posts without images, GIFs, or video. Quoted posts with media stay visible.
en.settings_filter_hide_reposts_desc: Filter posts that can be identified as reposts or RTs.
en.settings_filter_hide_replies_desc: Filter content that X marks as a reply to another post.
en.settings_filter_keywords_desc: One keyword per line. Matching post or quoted-post text is hidden.
en.settings_filter_keywords_placeholder:
Example: spoilers
raffle
topic to skip
en.settings_filter_muted_users_desc: One username, display name, or user ID per line. @ is optional for usernames.
en.settings_read_aloud_entry_desc: When on, detail, bookmarks, lists, and profile pages show the floating read-aloud button. Turning it off hides the entry without stopping current playback.
en.settings_general_one_desc: Control default behavior in this category.
en.settings_general_three_desc: Review data use and access permissions.
en.reply_publish_failed: Unable to publish to X. Your content remains in the editor.
en.post_continue_in_x: X's composer is open. Confirm the post in X.
en.post_continue_in_x_with_media: X's composer is open. Add the media again and confirm the post in X.
en.post_open_web_failed: Unable to open a browser for this post. Try again.
en.post_send_unconfirmed: Publication is not confirmed. Your content remains in the editor. Check your X profile before retrying to avoid duplicate posts.
en.post_upload_needs_session: Attachments require an X web session. Sign in through the X login page before sending.
en.profile_likes_unavailable: Couldn't load liked posts. Pull down to retry.
en.profile_not_ready: Profile is still loading, try again
